headline: Indices grinding straight up in extensions into month-end, but Bank + Crude + Euro warn a dollar-strength reversal is loading — VIX 18.85 is the trigger.
market_state: Range-bound ~8 weeks; risk-off hedging into weekends; USD negatively correlated with indices (30d & 15d); regime flip-flopping inflationary bust/boom (crude + S&P sideways). Last day of July (month-end). Econ: Employment Cost Index 8:30, Chicago PMI 9:45 (exp 55.9), U-Mich sentiment 10:00. Fed-watch: 67.4% prob of a Sept hike.
bias: Short-term BULLISH while extensions hold (VIX < 18.85 and DXY below its 61.8%). Structurally BEARISH building: Bank in a confirmed head-&-shoulders downtrend (the ONLY leading indicator confirming weakness), crude breaking out of shorts (inflationary), euro confirming the dollar-strength trade, and a yen carry-trade unwind starting.

es.current_mm: Read off his SETTLED 4h fib (red/yellow levels, green target). Active 4h SHORT measured move: 100% anchor 7632.35 (range high = the daily -23.6% ceiling) -> 0% anchor 7411.75 (swing low). 61.8% FAILURE (red) 7547.86, 50% (yellow) 7521.88, 38.2% 7495.89, -23.6% TARGET (green) 7359.77. Price ~7510 sits between the 38.2% and 50%. HTF daily UP-MM (Low 6353.25 -> High 7648.75) already hit its -23.6% target 7632.25 = the ceiling this short hangs from.
es.trend: Range-bound ~8 weeks under 7632-7648. SERIES = SHORTS from the range top (4h short fib active). Near-term it's bouncing UP in extensions off the 7411 low toward the 61.8% (7547.86); the larger short re-engages if 7547.86 caps it (esp. with VIX>18.85). Bullish only if it reclaims >7547.86 with VIX<18.85.

We're going straight up in extensions on the indices as long as the VIX holds below its 18.85.
Crude oil rallying away from its support... is a bearish sign for the indices.

other_notes: Leading-indicator scoreboard: only BANK is confirming the indices weakness so far; VIX and DXY have NOT yet. Crypto (BTC/ETH) choppy in head-&-shoulders, ~80% through the 'crypto winter'. Silver bearish <59.76.
